title: Re-Handling and the Shrink Percentage Taken for Each Point
content:
The percentage taken for each point of moisture turns on how often the grain has been handled, every trip through the leg costing bushels. This rule governs conditioning shrink on Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements.

## Clause

Where more than one conditioning charge has been raised on the agreement in the last twelve months, the programme's handling shrink percentage carries the re-handling step of 0.10 of a percentage point.

Where one conditioning charge has been raised in the last twelve months and a turning charge stands on the account, the programme's percentage carries the turning step of 0.06 of a percentage point.

And otherwise the programme's percentage is taken as it stands.

## The programme's handling shrink percentage

| Programme | Handling shrink for each point (percent) |
| --- | --- |
| Open Storage Account | 0.50 |
| Grain Bank Deposit Account | 0.50 |
| Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage | 0.50 |
| Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement | 0.50 |
| Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement | 0.40 |
| Identity Preserved Segregated Storage | 0.40 |

## The branches side by side

| Conditioning charges raised on the agreement in the last twelve months | A turning charge stands on the account | Percentage taken for each point |
| --- | --- | --- |
| more than one | either way | the programme's percentage with 0.10 added |
| exactly one | yes | the programme's percentage with 0.06 added |
| exactly one | no | the programme's percentage as it stands |
| none | either way | the programme's percentage as it stands |

## Worked percentages, on hypothetical accounts

**A Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement with three conditioning charges raised over the last twelve months.** More than one, so the percentage is 0.40 with 0.10 added, which is 0.50 for each point.

**An Open Storage Account with one conditioning charge over the twelve months and a turning charge standing on the account.** The percentage is 0.50 with 0.06 added, which is 0.56 for each point.

**An Open Storage Account with one conditioning charge over the twelve months and no turning charge on the account.** The percentage stands at 0.50 for each point.
